title: onboard-visuals-packaging-annotation-guidelines-for-model-launches
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact, production-ready pack of onboarding and release screenshots that cover new model launch, pricing tiers, and deprecation states. Deliverables must include variations for release notes, in-console hero, quickstart modal, and a spritesheet for web docs. Provide explicit annotation guidelines (callouts, copy snippets, and accessibility notes) so PMs and engineering can reuse assets without additional design handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file contains finalized artboards: release-hero, quickstart-modal, pricing-tooltips, deprecation-banner, and docs-spritesheet (2x @1x and @2x exports)
Annotation guide page with standardized callout components, copy snippets, and recommended alt-text for each screenshot
Accessible color contrast verified (AA) for all overlays and badges and documented in the guide
PM review approved in Figma and release notes PR references the exported assets
Hand-off checklist completed: export tokens, file naming conventions, and illustration usage rules
updates: 2026-02-12 - Initial brief received from PM (Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/Launchpad/Model-Launch-Assets). Focus: make pricing visible without exposing internal tier names.
2026-02-18 - Wireframes uploaded to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/launchpad-onboard-wires. Noted: need explicit deprecation badge states (sunset, deprecated, archived).
2026-02-22 - Design critique: avoid heavy drop shadows on hero; use thin outline and 8px rounded corners. Feedback logged in Figma comments (tagged @Tara Patel).

2026-02-25 - PM request: add lightweight pricing tooltip with microcopy ‘estimated per-1K tokens’ and currency toggle. Draft tooltip copy added to annotations. See comment: https://www.figma.com/proto/comment/xyz
2026-03-02 - Engineering sync: ENG-4210 will ship an automated screenshot capture endpoint; asked for final artboards by 2026-03-10. Action: provide export presets and naming convention.
2026-03-08 - Accessibility review: contrast issues fixed for pricing pill and deprecation badge; tested with axe-core snapshot. Results attached.
2026-03-10 - Assets exported (dev-ready): /drive/Launchpad/exports/DES-35901/ (high-res and 1x). Shared with PM and Docs.
2026-03-12 - In-review: PM (Ivan Morales) left two copy edits for tooltip and deprecation microcopy; addressed in Figma and updated the guide. Awaiting final sign-off before closing.
2026-03-12 - Follow-up: created subtask for localization of tooltips and alt-text (PM-3301).
notes: Key design decisions: 1) Use neutral gray price pill with 1px border to avoid implying endorsement for tiers. 2) Deprecation badge uses orange outline + reduced opacity background to balance visibility with non-interference. 3) All screenshots include a single-line caption and standardized copy tokens for feature names to avoid mismatches across docs. Engineering requested naming convention: catalog_release_<model>_<asset>-v1@1x.png and @2x for retina exports.
